Tokenize Korean news

Source: R/tokenize.R
tokenize_ko.Rd

Turns a news tibble into a long token table with one row per token.

Usage

tokenize_ko(
  news,
  field = c("keyword", "text", "title"),
  pos = "noun",
  stopwords = stopwords_ko(),
  min_nchar = 2,
  keep = NULL,
  dic = getOption("knewsr.mecab_dic", "")
)

Arguments

news

A tibble from as_news().

field

Column to tokenize: "keyword", "text" or "title".

pos

Part-of-speech tags to keep when analysing text. "noun" keeps common and proper nouns (NNG, NNP); otherwise a vector of Sejong tags such as c("NNG", "NNP", "VV"). Ignored for field = "keyword".

stopwords

Tokens to drop.

min_nchar

Drop tokens shorter than this many characters.

keep

Columns of news (e.g. "source", "date") to carry over to the token table, for grouped counts and keyness().

dic

Path to the mecab-ko-dic system dictionary, passed to RcppMeCab::pos() as sys_dic. "" uses the MeCab default. Set it once with options(knewsr.mecab_dic = "...").

Value

A tibble with doc_id, the keep columns and token, in text order.

Details

With field = "keyword" (the default) the comma-separated BigKinds keyword column is split, which is fast and needs no morphological analyser. With field = "text" or "title" the text is analysed with MeCab-ko through the RcppMeCab package, which needs a system MeCab installation and the mecab-ko-dic dictionary.

Examples

news <- as_news(president_lee_2026_08)
#> Detected columns: doc_id <- `뉴스 식별자`, date <- `일자`, source <- `언론사`, title <- `제목`, keyword <- `키워드`
tokenize_ko(news, keep = "source")
#> # A tibble: 63,945 × 3
#>    doc_id                     source token       
#>    <chr>                      <chr>  <chr>       
#>  1 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 뉴스룸      
#>  2 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 이승준      
#>  3 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 정치데스크  
#>  4 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 전쟁        
#>  5 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 17          
#>  6 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 전당대회    
#>  7 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 더불어민주당
#>  8 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 전당        
#>  9 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 대회        
#> 10 01101001.20260831191916001 한겨레 가지        
#> # ℹ 63,935 more rows

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# needs MeCab-ko and mecab-ko-dic on the system
tokenize_ko(news, field = "title")
} # }
